This '''battleship''' was under the control of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ludo Kressh]] in the years leading up to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. It was one of the few ships in Kressh's control which survived the [[Battle of Khar Delba]], but was later destroyed when Kressh decided to fake his [[Death/Legends|death]].
